did: Studio's Templates page now draws every frame of an episode before anything is filled, with the AI's part shown as grey bars. Studio has a Library of clips, each showing what a change built as a user sees it, and every user-facing change is now meant to leave one. And a session now writes a short note like this one before it is archived, so the weekly call hears what it did.

calls.title: Every storyboard is pinned as a file
options: Pin each template's storyboard beside its formats
Compute it live on the phone
calls.why: The phone can't carry the code that makes the call's or Playoff Delta's episodes, so it reads a pinned copy that tests hold equal to that code.
calls.undo: Once a template's code is on the phone's path, compute its storyboard live and drop the pin.

calls.title: Clips are stills with labels, not video
options: Each side of a clip is labelled stills
Each side of a clip is a video
calls.why: Stills are what the walk command already writes, and they are a HyperFrames scene's input as they stand; a video would need captions and a recorder the phone doesn't have.
calls.undo: Add a video side to the clip index's schema and to the Library's clip page.

left: The first real clip: no change has left one yet; the next user-facing change makes it.
Command-line clips wait on the CARDS epic.
Picking a clip for an episode isn't built; the Library only lists them.
The clip check reads a walk with its own small schema; it could share the walk command's now that it has landed.
The call's facts command doesn't read session notes yet; the routine reads them by hand.
